source_export.usage: lexical similarity screening and coverage prioritization only
source_export.runtime_availability: raw ZIP mounted and parsed locally

methodology.normalization: HTML removed; Unicode NFKD; lowercase alphanumeric tokenization; whitespace compacted
methodology.external_screen: Each committed stem compared with all 7,937 exported stem_signal values
methodology.within_batch: All 190 stem pairs compared using exact equality, five-token Jaccard, and character ratio
methodology.scope_limit: This is lexical screening, not a substitute for human semantic/copyright review or clinician review

results.disposition: No lexical quarantine flags; retain as private drafts pending human similarity, factual, media, and clinician review

reviewer_notes: No proprietary stem, option, explanation, screenshot, or media is intentionally copied.
The source ZIP was used only for coverage signals and lexical comparison.
Low lexical overlap does not prove semantic originality; human similarity review remains required.
No import, merge, deployment, student exposure, or publication is authorized.
